description: Block AI crawlers on ari.denmei.org Ryuseigai
expression: (http.host eq "ari.denmei.org" and (http.request.uri.path eq "/ryuseigai" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/ryuseigai/")) and (cf.verified_bot_category in {"AI Crawler" "AI Assistant" "AI Search"} or lower(http.user_agent) contains "gptbot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "oai-searchbot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "chatgpt-user" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "claudebot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "claude-searchbot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "claude-user" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "perplexitybot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "perplexity-user"))
